tagline.en: A WorldFoundry-native PI0 profile, routed through the same in-tree OpenPI runtime as the standard pi0.
tagline.zh: WorldFoundry 原生的 PI0 配置，与标准 pi0 走同一套内置 OpenPI 运行时。

en: PI0 (WorldFoundry native) is a WorldFoundry-integrated profile of Physical Intelligence's PI0 vision-language-action model. It shares the same in-tree OpenPI runtime as the standard pi0 entry, packaged as a native extension so PI0 fits directly into WorldFoundry's action-generation workflow.
Like pi0, it maps observations and a language instruction into robot actions and emits an action trace. The default runtime uses a DROID-oriented policy configuration.
Running full PI0 inference requires the local checkpoint together with its tokenizer and normalization statistics, which are staged separately before you roll it out.
zh: PI0（WorldFoundry 原生）是 Physical Intelligence 的 PI0 视觉-语言-动作模型在 WorldFoundry 内的集成配置。它与标准 pi0 条目共用同一套内置 OpenPI 运行时，以原生扩展的形式打包，使 PI0 直接融入 WorldFoundry 的动作生成流程。
与 pi0 一样，它把观测和一条语言指令映射为机器人动作，并输出一段动作轨迹。默认运行时采用面向 DROID 的策略配置。
运行完整的 PI0 推理需要本地 checkpoint，以及配套的 tokenizer 和归一化统计量，这些资源需在推演前单独准备。

whenToUse.en: Use this profile when you want PI0 wired natively into WorldFoundry's action pipeline — the same OpenPI-backed policy, packaged as a WorldFoundry extension.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想让 PI0 原生接入 WorldFoundry 动作流程时，可使用这个配置——同一套由 OpenPI 支撑的策略，以 WorldFoundry 扩展的形式打包。

notFor.en: An action-generation policy, not a video model. Full inference needs a local checkpoint, tokenizer, and normalization assets, all staged separately.
notFor.zh: 它是动作生成策略，而非视频模型。完整推理需要本地 checkpoint、tokenizer 与归一化资源，均需单独准备。
